refuted_by: Independent adjudication (sre agent, did not write this change): recompute_metrics (agent_registry.cpp:2406) takes only AgentHealthStore::mu_ and does pure in-memory work (no I/O, DB, network or callback); upsert holds mu_ for bounded CPU work and calls the corruption sink OUTSIDE it (agent_registry.cpp:2342). There is no try/catch around the loop (server.cpp:9262-9945), so an uncaught exception calls std::terminate and the whole server aborts, which the process-up signal shows; it does not leave frozen gauges. A stall or hang DOES stop yuzu_server_reaper_sweep_duration_seconds_count (observed on the same thread, server.cpp:9942-9945) and docs/user-manual/metrics.md:2046-2048 names it as the sweep-liveness signal. This change adds only in-memory lookups (about +1.7 ms per 10,000 agents).
refuted_by_reporter: sre (independent same-session governance agent; not the change's author and not the reporter, unhappy-path)
classification_rationale: if the recompute sweep stalls the gauges keep their last value
summary: Raised as speculative at Gate 4 (I3 derives HIGH). REFUTED as stated: 'nothing signals the stall' is false (the sweep-duration histogram does and the docs name it) and 'the thread dies silently' is false (it terminates the process). A TRUE RESIDUE remains and is NOT closed here: no shipped alert watches that histogram (grep of docs/prometheus finds none), so a blocked sweep that is not a crash is visible only to someone reading it. That is a pre-existing property of every yuzu_fleet_* gauge, not introduced or worsened by this change; no issue has been filed for it (suggested: an `increase(yuzu_server_reaper_sweep_duration_seconds_count[5m]) == 0` stall alert guarded against absence).

Resolved by a CODE READ (offline agents get no queued commands; send_to returns false; gw_pending_ is not requeued), not by running it, so epistemic status stays likely. Wording corrected in 8d2753c4d, then again in 5ffc843a9 after security-guardian showed the gateway forward is tried up to three times with the same command id (another redelivery path) and that 'avoid restarting during a re-drive' has no safety basis.
